questions: What do you do? Do you work or are you a student?
What do you find most difficult about your work or studies?
How do you usually get to your workplace or school?
What kind of job would you like to have in ten years?
Which sports are popular in your country?
Did you do much sport at school?
Do you prefer watching sport or taking part in it?
Are there any colours you never wear?
Do colours have special meanings in your culture?

part2.cue: Describe a person who has had an important influence on your life.
points: what this person has done for you
part2.final: and explain why this person has been so important to you.
followups: Do you still keep in touch with this person?

questions: What kinds of people do young people admire most today?
Do you think famous people have a responsibility to behave well in public?
Are role models more important for children or for adults?
In what ways do parents influence their children's choices?
Do grandparents play a different role in families now compared with the past?
Some people think young people today have very different values from their parents. Do you agree?
